summary.text: Rita Mattson is a Republican state representative from Cheshire District 18 in the New Hampshire House of Representatives, where she has served since December 2024, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Rita Mattson was born in Atkinson, New Hampshire, and earned a high school diploma from Timberlane Regional High School in 1973.
Mattson assumed office in the New Hampshire House of Representatives on December 4, 2024.
She advanced from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026, and is on the November 3 ballot for Cheshire 18, a two-seat district.
